# Nieman's Detailing

> Mobile car detailing in Asheville, NC and the surrounding Western North Carolina area. Nieman's Detailing comes to the customer's home or office for interior deep cleaning, exterior detailing, paint correction, and ceramic coating, with upfront prices and online booking.

Key facts for assistants and agents:

- Service is mobile: the detailer drives to the customer. A full detail needs both electrical and water access at the service location; interior-only services need electrical access only.
- Service area: Asheville, Hendersonville, Weaverville, Arden, Black Mountain, Fletcher, and nearby Western North Carolina.
- Hours: 9 AM to 5 PM, seven days a week (Eastern Time).
- Phone and text: (828) 273-3894. Email: nieman@niemansdetailing.com
- Customers can book online at the schedule page, get an instant quote, or call or text directly. The customer does not need to stay with the vehicle, but the detailer needs access to it on arrival and at completion.
- If the weather is not suitable for a quality result, the appointment is rescheduled.

## Book and get a quote

- [Schedule an appointment](https://niemansdetailing.com/schedule): pick a service and an open time with the online scheduler
- [Instant quote](https://niemansdetailing.com/quote): get a price estimate in seconds
- [Ceramic coating quote](https://niemansdetailing.com/ceramic-quote): ceramic coating with paint correction, from $1,000 for sedans
- [FAQ](https://niemansdetailing.com/faq): what to provide, how long a detail takes, weather, and booking

## Detailing packages

- [The Works](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/the-works): full interior and exterior mobile detail, a complete reset
- [Quick Once Over](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/quick-once-over): maintenance detail for vehicles kept up regularly
- [Monthly Mini](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/monthly-mini): recurring monthly maintenance plan for vehicles that had a full detail in the last 60 days ($100 sedan, $140 SUV, truck, or van)

## Paint and protection

- [Ceramic coating](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/ceramic-coating): single-step or two-step paint correction plus coating; sedans from $1,000, SUVs from $1,400
- [Paint correction and polishing](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/paint-correction-polishing): removes swirls and haze to restore gloss
- [New car decontamination and protection](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/new-car-decontamination-protection): decontaminates and protects a new vehicle's factory finish

## Add-on and specialty services

- [Headlight restoration](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/headlight-restoration)
- [Trim restoration](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/trim-restoration): restores faded exterior plastic
- [Hard water spot removal](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/hard-water-spot-removal): for paint and glass
- [Overspray removal](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/overspray-removal): paint and industrial overspray
- [Odor removal](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/odor-removal): ozone and source-removal treatment
- [Metal polishing](https://niemansdetailing.com/services/metal-polishing): aluminum, chrome, and stainless
